title: Each coordinator turn ends with a check of every live session, and a board it rewrites
why: Plan R54 (owner 13:15 CST Nov 12; rewritten after his 13:20 CST pick a, restart-plan aa190fd): "this is good, it can be an active nudger / checker against coordinator too right".
note: Home: decision session-tiers. (1) At each publish and each batch merge, the roadmap build (its --live sessions read, every page of the session list) lists each session the coordinator started that is not archived and is silent, waiting for action, or done. (2) Triage writes that list, with each session's step and PR, to the record branch. (3) Triage sends the coordinator each flagged line; its next report names an act for each: archive, nudge, or a reason to wait. (4) No read at the end of each turn. Lane session_013NEJL3bD7WV2R2WrMqh5Xz, re-pointed 13:23 CST. Coordinator split 13:36 CST Nov 12: three PRs, --live via merge --idle-lanes, the board, the report guard.
